user_goal.ko: 뒤섞인 입사 준비 업무를 시점, 담당, 의존성에 따라 실행 가능한 체크리스트로 만든다.
user_goal.en: Turn mixed onboarding notes into an actionable checklist organized by timing, owner, and dependency.

task.expected_artifact: A structured checklist for pre-start, day one, week one, and first 30 days.

messages.content:
다음 신입 입사 준비 업무를 입사 전, 첫날, 첫 주, 첫 30일로 나눠 체크리스트로 정리해줘. 각 항목에 알려진 담당자와 의존성을 표시하고, 담당자나 승인 경로가 없는 항목은 지어내지 말고 '미정'으로 표시해.

- People Ops: 시작 5일 전 환영 메일
- IT: 서명된 고용계약을 받은 뒤 계정 생성
- IT: 시작 10영업일 전 노트북 주문
- 직원: 시작 3일 전 급여 서류 제출
- People Ops: 첫날 오리엔테이션 예약
- 매니저: 버디 지정
- 직원: 5일 이내 보안교육 완료
- 직원: 7일 이내 복리후생 등록
- 매니저: 30일 체크인
- 건물 출입증: 시작 2일 전 요청, 담당자 기록 없음
- 추가 모니터: 역할상 필요할 때 요청, 승인 경로 기록 없음

온보딩 할거 막 섞여있는데 정리좀: people ops 웰컴메일 시작5일전, signed contract 와야 IT 계정만듬, 노트북은 IT가 10영업일전, 급여서류 직원이 3일전. 첫날 orientation은 people ops, manager가 buddy 정함. 보안교육 직원 day5까지, benefits day7까지, manager 30day checkin. 출입증은 2일전 신청인데 owner 메모없고 extra monitor는 필요시인데 누가 approve하는지도 없음. pre-start/day1/week1/30days로 나누고 담당/선행조건 같이, 모르는건 알아서 만들지말고 미정으로

Organize these new-hire tasks into a checklist for pre-start, day one, week one, and the first 30 days. Show the known owner and dependency for each item. If an owner or approval path is missing, label it 'TBD' instead of inventing one.

- People Ops: welcome email five days before start
- IT: create accounts after receiving the signed employment agreement
- IT: order laptop ten business days before start
- Employee: submit payroll forms three days before start
- People Ops: schedule day-one orientation
- Manager: assign buddy
- Employee: finish security training by day five
- Employee: complete benefits enrollment by day seven
- Manager: 30-day check-in
- Building pass: request two days before start; owner not recorded
- Extra monitor: request if the role needs it; approval path not recorded

onboarding list is all mixed up can you sort it: people ops welcome email 5 days before, IT accounts only after signed agreement, IT laptop 10 biz days before, employee payroll forms 3 days before. day1 orientation people ops, manager assigns buddy, employee security training by day5 and benefits by day7, manager 30day checkin. building pass needs request 2 days before but notes dont say owner. extra monitor if role needs it but no approval path written down. group prestart/day1/week1/first30, show owner + dependencies and put TBD where we actually dont know

invariants: Preserve every stated deadline and owner.
Make the signed employment agreement a dependency for account creation.
Label the building-pass owner as TBD.
Label the extra-monitor approval path as TBD.
Place security training and benefits enrollment in week one and the manager check-in in the first 30 days.
failure_signals: Missing owners or approval paths are invented.
A deadline is moved to the wrong phase.
Items are dropped from the checklist.
